name: fdsi-figma-sync
description: Figma plugin that syncs fdsi-icons between this repo and a Figma library.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:ui
scripts.test: esbuild tests/contract.test.ts tests/svg-translate.test.ts tests/svg-optimize.test.ts tests/scan.test.ts tests/meta-build.test.ts tests/commit-changes.test.ts tests/library.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.tmp/tests --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test .tmp/tests/*.test.mjs
